title: The Masquerade Mask Deduction
description:
🧩 Locked Filing Cabinet: Red Mask, Blue Mask, Gold Mask.
1. The killer wore a Gold Mask.
2. Lady Clara did NOT wear a Gold Mask.
3. Duke Thomas wore a Red Mask.
question: Which guest wore the Gold Mask?
hints: Three guests: Lady Clara, Duke Thomas, Lord Vaughan.
Lady Clara did NOT wear Gold Mask (so Clara = Blue Mask). Lord Vaughan must wear Gold Mask.
solution: Duke Thomas = Red Mask. Lady Clara != Gold Mask -> Clara = Blue Mask. Lord Vaughan = Gold Mask.
